summary: Phase 18.5 testing complete. Verified (A) BreezeDocs completed→auto-invoice flow + idempotency + skip cases, (B) Phase 1 Nifty onboarding actionable-error UX, (C) /admin/onboarding/health snapshot + /admin/onboarding/replay-failed gating, (D) admin onboarding banner UI + 'Connect Nifty →' navigation. 9 new pytests + 3 new e2e pytests + 42 regression tests = 54 PASSED, 0 FAILED.
critical_code_review_comments: OnboardingAdmin.jsx 'Connect Nifty →' is rendered as a <button> with onClick navigate — semantically would be better as a Link/<a href> for middle-click / open-in-new-tab support, but functionally works.

test_breezedocs_auto_invoice.py uses module-level `asyncio.get_event_loop()` which is deprecated in Python 3.12+. Works on 3.11 (current env) but consider switching to `asyncio.new_event_loop()` or pytest-asyncio markers when bumping Python.
Auto-invoice helper signature `_maybe_auto_invoice_on_completion(db, request, proposal)` is solid; idempotency via linked_invoice_id is correctly persisted before the second call returns None.

Actionable error rewrite in onboarding_routes.py only triggers when error string startswith 'nifty not connected'. If NiftyClient ever returns a slightly different phrase ('not connected to nifty', 'token missing'), the rewrite is bypassed. Consider broader match (e.g., status==0 with empty token) for resilience.
seed_data_creation: All test fixtures self-clean: synthetic proposals/invoices/onboardings are deleted in test teardown (cleanup blocks in finally clauses).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 18.5 covers BreezeDocs auto-invoice on completion + actionable Nifty disconnect UX. Nifty is intentionally disconnected; reconnecting requires OAuth handshake by the admin. Red banner verified live at /admin/onboarding with the exact wording: 'Nifty isn't connected — phase tasks aren't syncing | 1 onboarding is waiting for Nifty. Connect it once and we'll auto-backfill every queued task. | Connect Nifty →'. The amber retry banner only renders when nifty_connected==true AND onboardings_with_errors>0 — could not be reproduced in this env (Nifty disconnected). The e2e test test_manual_sync_returns_invoice_created exercises POST /api/admin/breezedocs/proposals/{id}/sync against a seeded synthetic proposal; the route exists and returns invoice_created field correctly. Phase 18.5 is production-ready.
